$comment: Machine-readable list of migrations that are removed from the default execution path. Consumed by tools/migrate.mjs, tools/smoke.mjs and the tests. A file listed here is never executed by `npm run db:deploy`, never mirrored into supabase/schema.sql, and never shipped as a supabase/setup chunk. See ../../../docs/DB-MIGRATIONS.md.

quarantined.reason: Table-wide historical rewrite: UPDATE public.daily_login_rewards SET reward = 0 WHERE reward <> 0, plus a table-wide CHECK (reward = 0). It irreversibly overwrites recorded check-in amounts, so it can never run against a database that has history.
destructiveStatements: update public.daily_login_rewards set reward = 0 where reward <> 0
quarantined.ifAlreadyApplied: Leave the history row alone. 20261119 and 20261120 are safe to run afterwards; they remove the table-wide CHECK and install the immutability trigger. Reward values already zeroed by this migration are NOT restored — restoring them is the separate administrator-only repair described in 20261120.
